data.one_liner: An image zoom package with pinch, hover, and tap interactions.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable widgets for zooming images and other content via pinch gestures, hover effects, mouse regions, and taps. Supports custom border radius, scale limits, aspect ratios, and clip behavior.
use_when: You need pinch-to-zoom capabilities for images or other widgets.
You want hover-based zoom or tap-to-zoom functionality on desktop or web platforms.
avoid_when: You need a complete photo gallery view with page swiping and advanced caching (use photo_view or cached_network_image instead).
strengths: Supports multiple interaction types (pinch, hover, tap, mouse region).
Easy integration with customizable scaling limits and border radii.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on some advanced properties beyond the basic examples.
Relies on custom state management widgets rather than being fully integrated with standard interactive viewer controllers.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: More robust, battle-tested solution specifically designed for photo zooming, panning, and galleries.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you primarily need network image loading and caching alongside basic display.
